temperature, top_p or top_k return 400 on {target}: at any value under API version 2026-10-21 (sent by anthropic Python >= 2.0.0 and @anthropic-ai/sdk >= 1.0.0), and at a non-default value under 2023-06-01. Removing them is the documented fix and changes behaviour.

{target} is not documented as rejecting temperature, top_p or top_k on API version 2023-06-01; on 2026-10-21 (sent by anthropic Python >= 2.0.0 and @anthropic-ai/sdk >= 1.0.0) they return 400 on every model.

options.label: think only between tools
options.effect: Closest to the old model: no thinking before the answer. Without tools the response contains only text; with tools, the short updates written between tool calls come back as thinking blocks. Accepted at low, medium and high effort; at xhigh or max effort the call returns 400.

options.label: let the model think
options.effect: The model thinks adaptively at its default effort (high). A response can begin with thinking blocks, so code that reads content[0].text breaks; max_tokens covers thinking plus text, and thinking tokens are billed as output tokens, so calls are slower and costlier when it thinks. How much it thinks on real prompts is not measured yet.

rules.message: {target} thinks by default (adaptive thinking) when the call sends no thinking; the model it replaces answered without thinking.

options.label: think only between tools
options.effect: No thinking before the answer, as the call asked. Without tools the response contains only text; with tools, the updates written between tool calls come back as thinking blocks. At xhigh or max effort the call returns 400.

options.label: let the model think
options.effect: The model thinks adaptively at its default effort (high), although the call had turned thinking off: slower and costlier when it thinks, and a response can begin with thinking blocks.
